turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My bread is always dense and kind of heavy. I follow the recipe exactly.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Two big culprits are under kneading and under proofing. How long do you knead?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Five minutes maybe? My arms get tired.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Most doughs need closer to ten by hand. Try the windowpane test, stretch a small piece thin, and if light shines through without tearing, it's ready.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: go by the time in the recipe.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Times are only a guide. Your kitchen might be cooler than theirs. Wait until the dough has properly doubled, even if that takes longer.
